ambiguities.text: The specification says 'None' for security considerations but pagination introduces new attack surface for unvalidated buffering
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementations must bound buffer sizes and apply the recommended sanity checks to prevent memory exhaustion attacks. Treat this as a security requirement even though not explicitly stated.

ambiguities.text: The exact message size limit that triggers pagination is not specified, only that 'message-size rejection thresholds' exist
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume typical devp2p message size limits around 10-24 MiB. Implementations should configure this based on their network protocol version.

ambiguities.text: The calculation for maximum receipt size (gas limit / 8) is stated as a bound but the derivation is not fully explained
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this is derived from the maximum log data that could be emitted relative to gas cost. Cap at ~2 MiB per receipt as stated.

implicit_assumptions.description: Peers are assumed to eventually provide complete receipt data through multiple paginated requests
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious peers could send incomplete data and never complete pagination, stalling sync. Implementations need request timeouts and peer rotation.

implicit_assumptions.description: Block gas limits have increased to ~83M, making receipt lists potentially exceed 10 MiB
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If gas limits decrease or receipt sizes change, pagination may become unnecessary overhead

implicit_assumptions.description: All eth/70 implementations will use consistent message size limits for triggering pagination
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inconsistent limits could cause interoperability issues where some peers expect pagination that others don't provide

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot forge receipt data that passes the sanity checks but represents invalid state
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Forged receipts could mislead light clients or cause state inconsistencies if validation checks are insufficient
